section.6: The Book of the Times (of Prayer)

6.name_native: The Book of the Times (of Prayer)

hadiths.text: It was narrated that Jabir said:"The sun set when the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was in Makkah, and he joined the two prayers in Sarif.: [1] [1] A valley about 12 km northeast of Makkah on the way to Al-Madinah
